facts.business: SIL Investments Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in investment activities including quoted and unquoted equity shares, bonds, alternate investment funds, and mutual funds.
key_risks: Valuation of unquoted investments involves significant estimation uncertainty, subjective assumptions and application of significant judgment
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions that were entered into during the financial year were on an arm's length basis and were in the ordinary course of business. All Related Party Transactions are placed before the Audit Committee and also the Board for approval. Prior omnibus approval of the Audit Committee is obtained on an annual basis for transactions which are of a foreseen and repetitive nature.
